option_A.change: New assigned-target profile in existing runner; freeze native target need_ref in task envelope with no route/disposition/rationale gold. New independent contract/root/limits; rerun full source selection, Reflect and Controller prefix.
option_A.evidence: Fresh end-to-end small composition under new assignment; original v1 remains 0/1, no transfer of successful prefix claims to new role outputs.
option_A.risk: Repeats already successful costly semantic prefix, introduces different selected originals/reflection and changes more than task assignment. More requests and more moving parts; not minimal discriminator.

option_B_recommended.allowed_actions: Only native backlog inspect if required and record_need_dispositions for the assigned native need. Full backlog stays visible/order unchanged; stage envelope states assigned target and stops at first original accepted progress-unit write, even if semantically wrong. Wrong target/unsupported action/correction exhaustion retains failure and original answer.
option_B_recommended.boundary: New assigned Controller-only experiment branching at sealed pre-first-Controller frontier. It imports accepted input artifacts as immutable provenance, not old execution authority and not a resume of v1. Old other-need unit is retained as provenance, not credited/applied a second time.
option_B_recommended.counts_and_acceptance: New target denominator 1, old v1 0/1 retained. First answer, native correction, raw/cache/receipt, row validation, exact native saved unit and pending target reviewed separately. No answer/route oracle reaches role. Budget requires root freeze; initial+one existing native correction is sufficient proposed minimum, no automatic extension.
inputs: All 265 backlog rows/order and native target identity from sealed manifest+factory.
Exact accepted slow_input/sampling, slow_memory_delta, full 603908 provenance hash, six disclosure originals, briefs, and factory research_axis/label_map.
Frozen approved case objects selected in original sampling order, existing qualified 1780 view, exact stable catalog/spec/skills, native identity guards and measurable evidence manifest.
Real native memory index reconstructed from bound historical meta archive/profiles and accepted comparison sources/episodes; original schema/scope validation retained.

Constructor parameters absent from factory JSON: case_pairs, measurable_evidence_manifest, catalog/originals, identity_aliases, attribute_vocabulary, memory_index, native heavy/light/browse limits. Freeze or reconstruct them from exact named sources; no defaults guessed to match outcome.
minimal_product_refactor: Extract current Controller constructor plus its original need-progress persistence closure into one private shared builder/sink used by _run_controller_mining_axis and the thin diagnostic. Preserve all arguments, original unit path recipe and _write_or_verify_json behavior. No general continuation framework/public schema.

Factor the existing pure ReflectionMemoryIndex construction block only if necessary for exact rebuilding; both native context and diagnostic use the same source/scope algorithm. Never call _mining_context or _slow_method_view in this Controller-only boundary because their optional role reads would replay semantic prefix.
option_B_recommended.new_authority: Separate fixed destination/profile and fresh explicitly authorized limited Controller budget, not original run_contract or remaining old allowance. If a contract is used, bind identical copies at actual workspace and stage. No complete_cycle, original source/reflect calls, Engine-prefix-success claim, stable publication or duplicate learning event credit.
option_B_recommended.pre_dispatch_gate: Construct actual Controller with the shared builder, execute the same controlled inspect_catalog/backlog initialization, compare complete canonical first model view with original first inbox (including catalog, memory, page hash, base_hash and budget). Any unavoidable change must be explicit contract delta before execution; never coerce it away. The only planned semantic delta is wrapper task assignment of native need_ref, no route/answer.
option_B_recommended.proof_limit: Demonstrates actual native target handoff and sink from an accepted prefix; does not establish a fresh full Engine/S1-S2 run, autonomous task search, all-backlog processing, Mining/new measurement or independent benefit.
option_B_recommended.unverified: No Controller-frontier native reconstruction or equality probe executed in this design task. If original memory-index lineage cannot be reproduced exactly without a role, stop and revise boundary before new model request.

safe_preflight_proposal: Shared builder/sink versus original factory constructor arguments and exact saved unit equality; source hashes unchanged.
Reconstructed initial native view exact original-wire equality, including real memory index and six original disclosures; no caller allowed during prepare.
Assignment wrapper contains native need_ref but no route/gold; wrong/non-native/duplicate/removed target and source/code drift reject before first role.
Typed invalid row uses existing one correction; no accepted row means no sink success; partial sibling rows/pending count remain native.
Old completed stage unchanged, new fresh fixed root/contract/limits and no source/reflect/Signal/label/GET/other seed/candidate actions.
scope: Design and persisted-source verification only. No native constructors, execution, role request, budget reuse, Signal, global source mutation, or old-stage reentry.

source_findings.finding: _run_controller_mining_axis calls _mining_context before making two seed Controllers. That context can request fresh original/method reads; calling the whole factory is not inherently Controller-only.

save_need_unit is a nested closure, not EvolutionWorkspace API. It writes native schema mining-need-disposition-unit-v1 to experiments/cycles/cycle-ID/mining_need_units/hash(axis,seed)/result_hash.json with _write_or_verify_json.

Original Controller validates issued base_hash, disclosed unresolved need refs, row semantics, retains invalid siblings, updates native pending state and calls progress sink only after accepted rows. No new task/answer schema is needed.
Real ReflectionMemoryIndex affects even initial meta_info. Replacing it with None or a replay facade changes the input; factory-input alone is insufficient.
Native memory-index construction uses PlanMetaMemory archive/profiles plus comparison sources/episodes under H1 scope. This is pure reconstructible work, distinct from later optional role reads.
